subject: Pricing options for high-throughput hosted API — Econify
messages:
From: Caroline Wu <caroline@econify.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial pricing ask — hosted API / 20B tokens

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking time the other week. We ran the forecast with product and expect to need roughly 18–25 billion tokens/month by Q4, concentrated on generation-heavy models (long-form summarization + search re-ranking). Our procurement team asked for a baseline rate card for hosted API (per 1K tokens) and any volume discount bands you offer — we also want to understand whether you offer a "bucketed credits" billing option with monthly true-up.

To make review faster, I attached a short forecast (econify-usage-forecast.xlsx). Key asks:
- Baseline per-1K-token price for standard hosted API (no dedicated GPUs)
- Discount schedule at 5B, 10B, 20B buckets and any floor pricing
- Any introductory credits or Q1 loss-leader pricing for a multi-quarter commit
- How model multipliers (e.g., for larger context models) affect price

We have a tentative deployment date of 2026-11-01. Can you send a write-up or sample rate card this week?

Best,
Caroline
Head of ML Platform, Econify

Attachment: econify-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Wu <caroline@econify.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial pricing ask — hosted API / 20B tokens

Hi Caroline — thanks for the forecast. High level: we can definitely support the volumes you describe on our hosted tier; pricing can be structured either as a straightforward per-1K-token banded schedule or as bucketed prepaid credits with a monthly reconciliation. I attached a short proposed rate card and a one-pager that outlines trade-offs.

Highlights (quick):
- Baseline (on-demand hosted API): $0.0024 per 1K tokens for standard generation model profiles.
- Band discounts: 5B: 10% off baseline; 10B: 18% off; 20B+: 26% off (these are list bands for hosted — larger discounts available for reserved capacity).
- Bucketed credits: we can offer a prepaid bucket with monthly true-up. For Q4 pilot, we can provide a $50k onboarding credit and 8 weeks of preferential capacity handling.
- Model multipliers: heavier-context or instruction-tuned models typically carry a 1.2–1.6x multiplier; we’ll map exact model SKUs to multiplier in the final SOW.

I’ll loop in Ben from sales to talk commercial structure and Marcus from finance for margin/floor checks.

Attachments: redwood-proposed-ratecard-q3.pdf (PDF, 28KB)

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Caroline Wu <caroline@econify.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial pricing ask — hosted API / 20B tokens

Laura / Marcus / Caroline — thanks. From a GTM/sales perspective, I recommend presenting two clean options to Econify to make procurement's job easy:

Option A — Banded list (simple):
- Up to 5B: $0.00216 per 1K (10% off)
- 5B–10B: $0.00197 per 1K (18% off)
- 10B–20B: $0.00178 per 1K (26% off from list)
- 20B+: $0.00162 per 1K (32% off) — promotional tier if they sign a 6-month commit

Option B — Bucketed prepaid with monthly true-up (preferred for predictable billing):
- Prepay buckets in 5B increments; apply a 3% premium to list but give a 12% commitment discount on the prepaid amount plus unused-token rollover for 30 days. Monthly true-up invoices for overage at the banded rates.
- Offer a Q4 'pilot' bucket (5B) with a $50k onboarding credit and 50% of the pilot bucket refundable if they convert to a 6-month commit.

Rationale: procurement prefers deterministic invoices. Bucketed prepay locks consumption and improves collection predictability for us; the 3% premium offsets volatility. Offering rollover/use-it-or-convert reduces procurement friction.

Caroline — if you prefer, I can draft sample invoice language and a short SOW for the pilot bucket.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Caroline Wu <caroline@econify.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial pricing ask — hosted API / 20B tokens

Quick finance check: margins and floor.
- At purely hosted on-demand (no reserved capacity) our unit cost at 20B modeled with current spot GPU mix sits around $0.00105 per 1K tokens (including infra, networking, and amortized infra ops). That means a 32% discount at $0.00162 still leaves us ~35% gross margin.
- If we add rollover and refundable pilot language, we should shorten refund window to 30 days and cap refundable amount to the onboarding credit + 25% of the pilot bucket to limit downside.
- If Econify insists on model-multiplier flattening, require explicit model-mapping in SOW and add a 1.25x surcharge for any unanticipated 2.0x+ multipliers.

I’m comfortable agreeing to Option B with the following constraints captured in SOW: 6-month visibility commit for promotional 20B+ tier, 30-day refund/rollover, and specific model SKU multipliers. Ben, Laura — I think this is a solid position to present.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
